faqs.answer: Configuration drift occurs when engineers manually tweak cloud settings, leaving staging different from production. IaC detects and reconciles drift automatically on every Git commit.

it-consulting.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About IT Consulting in Dubai, UAE

faqs.question: Why should enterprises in Dubai hire Desert Whales Technologies for IT consulting?
faqs.answer: Desert Whales Technologies is an engineering-first consultancy, not a generic PowerPoint advisory firm. Our consultants are senior software architects and cloud engineers who actively build production systems. We maintain strict independence with zero software reseller commissions, providing unbiased advice that aligns technology investment with measurable business ROI.

faqs.question: How much do IT consulting services cost in Dubai, UAE?
faqs.answer: Our IT consulting engagements are structured around clear deliverables and milestone-based fixed fees or dedicated monthly advisory retainers. Focused technical audits (such as M&A Technical Due Diligence or Cloud FinOps Audits) typically range from AED 25,000 to AED 60,000. Comprehensive enterprise architecture roadmaps and Fractional CTO advisory retainers range from AED 35,000 to AED 75,000 per month.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a general management consultancy and your technical IT advisory?
faqs.answer: Traditional management consultancies provide high-level theoretical frameworks but rarely inspect code, review database query plans, or evaluate cloud infrastructure configs. We audit actual codebases, simulate server loads, analyze cloud network architectures, and deliver actionable blueprints that internal developers or external vendors can execute immediately.

faqs.question: Do you offer Fractional CTO / CIO advisory services in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. For high-growth startups and mid-market GCC enterprises that need senior technical leadership without the cost of a full-time executive, we provide Fractional CTO services. We lead architecture strategy, manage vendor tenders, conduct technical hiring interviews, and represent technology to investors and board members.

faqs.question: Can you help reduce our cloud hosting (AWS / Azure) and enterprise software licensing costs?
faqs.answer: Yes. In 90% of our enterprise audits, we identify 30% to 50% in recurring savings by eliminating oversized cloud compute instances, transitioning to spot and reserved pricing, containerizing legacy VMs, and renegotiating bloated enterprise software licenses.

faqs.question: How do you ensure IT compliance with UAE Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45)?
faqs.answer: We perform comprehensive data residency and governance audits to verify that personal customer and employee data remains within sovereign UAE data centers (such as AWS UAE or Microsoft Azure UAE North) and that access controls, encryption standards, and consent management meet Federal Decree-Law No. 45 requirements.

faqs.question: Can you evaluate potential technology acquisitions (Technical Due Diligence) in the UAE / GCC?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly conduct technical due diligence for private equity funds, family offices, and venture capital firms in DIFC and ADGM. We inspect codebase scalability, security vulnerabilities, open-source license compliance, intellectual property provenance, and true cloud operating costs.
